sar.narrative: On 2016-11-21 20:30:00, payment card C07297-K1 registered to customer C07297 was utilized in unauthorized transactions totaling $1906.07 USD via the online channel. Investigation revealed activity matching typology 'card_not_present_new_device', characterized by anomalous device fingerprinting (Trident/7.0 | Windows 7 | ie 11.0 for desktop). Analysis identified common infrastructure linking this compromise to 39 additional payment card(s). Cardholder inquiry verified that the primary account owner formally denied authorizing or executing the transactions while confirming continued physical possession of the card. Telemetry indicates that transaction velocity and parameters significantly deviate from established cardholder baseline profiles. Total cumulative unauthorized exposure identified across the compromise episode is $1906.07 USD. The financial institution has taken immediate mitigating action by declining pending transactions and blocking card C07297-K1 with reissue initiated. Heightened 72-hour fraud monitoring has been deployed across all connected accounts. This report is submitted pursuant to federal Bank Secrecy Act and FinCEN suspicious activity reporting mandates regarding suspected payment card compromise and illicit fund redirection.
